A '''data center''' was located within the [[Jebble]] [[Ice Citadel]]. It was here that [[Marn Hierogryph]] found the [[Jedi Covenant]]'s logs from [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. The [[data center]] was ravaged by [[Rakghoul]]s, before being destroyed in the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] bombardment.
